PlaneSite 1.6.13:
- Edit area outlines. Click the pencil next to an area (or double-click the area on the map) to show its corners: drag a corner to move it, drag or click a small middle dot to add a corner, right-click a corner (or click it and press Delete) to remove it. Ctrl+Z undoes, Done (Enter) saves, Cancel (Esc) puts it back. The acreage updates as you edit. Works on drawn, grid and imported areas.
- While drawing a polygon you can now drag the map to move around; only clicks place corners.
